info.title: schemorph — declarative, SQL-first schema management
info.description: Declarative, SQL-first schema management for SQL Server: diff for structure, idempotent re-definition for programmable objects, versioned migrations for data — one plan, one history ledger, agent-friendly output.

commands.name: apply
commands.description: execute the change plan and record it in the history ledger

options.name: --format
options.description:
output form (default: text)
connection:
--url can be omitted when the SCHEMORPH_URL environment variable is set
(preferred: keeps credentials out of shell history). Passwords are
redacted from every output channel.
Exit codes: 0 = success / no changes, 1 = error, 2 = diff found pending changes.
Errors are a typed envelope on stderr (docs/errors.md).

commands.name: diff
commands.description: compute the change plan (never applies anything)

options.name: --allow-destructive
options.description: include destructive changes in the plan

commands.name: inspect
commands.description: read a live database into desired-state SQL files

options.name: --allow-destructive
options.description:
apply destructive changes too
connection:
--url can be omitted when the SCHEMORPH_URL environment variable is set
(preferred: keeps credentials out of shell history). Passwords are
redacted from every output channel.
Exit codes: 0 = success / no changes, 1 = error, 2 = diff found pending changes.
Errors are a typed envelope on stderr (docs/errors.md).
